# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

ALVION PHARMACEUTICALS

# A science oriented pharmaceutical company

Developing and manufacturing noninfringing generic medicines in Europe.

# About us

Alvion is a science oriented pharmaceutical company developing and manufacturing non infringing
generic medicines in Europe. Collaborating with state of the art R&D centers in EU, Alvion is a
private and independent company focusing in R&D, IP, Quality, Regulatory and manufacturing of
generic and added value medicines, delivering an exceptional track record in the global
pharmaceutical market supplying millions of patients.

[Read more .][12]

# Why Alvion?

Developing, manufacturing, and promoting medicines in Europe, MENA, Canada, Australia, South Africa,
Australia, Asia and Latin America is the core business model of Alvion. **Focusing on delivering
innovation and best quality pharmaceuticals among the first companies prior the patent expiry while
offering flexible terms** and affordable medicines with an effective supply chain is major
competitive advantage of Alvion.

[Read more .][13]

[vision-card-icons]

## Our Vision

Alvion is a science pharmaceutical company offering difficult to develop and non-infringing products
to its partners, setting a new standard in generics by combining our experiences with an
understanding of the health care needs in a global level.

[flag-card-icons]

## Our Mission

Having diversified business model that enriches quality of life and delivers outstanding value to
all stakeholders.
[target-card-icons]

## Our Goal

is to become a leading and vertically integrated pharmaceutical company, establishing a global
presence, serving the healthcare communities and satisfying high performance employees.

Why collaborate with us:

# our partners’ success is our success

By raising the barrier of customer service and innovation, Alvion’s team is developing and producing
blockbuster molecules, registering the products across a wide territory. Alvion is offering a
complete and competitive “package” to its partners delivering end to end products and services at
all stages of the partnership.

[Read more .][14]

[alvion-collaborate]

# Partner with Alvion

Contact Business Development Department at [bd@alvionpharma.com][15]

# Innovation with a Global Presence

At Alvion, **we are rethinking pharmaceuticals with a new business model that creates the
pharmaceutical company of tomorrow.** We strive for a change that is clearly visible in the various
pharmaceutical markets, our model, processes and actions.

[Read more .][16]

[alvion-research]

# Research and Development

Developing in third parties’ high technology and non-infringing Intellectual Properties, often
patented technologies, Alvion is an IP powerhouse providing licensing rights to the largest
pharmaceutical companies in the world.

[Read more .][17]

# Products

Our people are a core aspect of Alvion’ s competitive advantage. We attract and retain key talents
with a high level of expertise and know-how who drive our business forward.

[Read more .][18]

# Innovations equals successful business

Alvion is welcoming business opportunities with multinational and strong local pharmaceutical
companies partnering with Alvion’s products via licensing agreements, both in the proprietary and
the supply.

[Read more .][19]

[avion-innovations]

# Our Sustainability Commitment

Alvion Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to creating a healthier future through responsible and
sustainable practices. Guided by **ESG principles**, we focus on reducing our environmental
footprint, continuously supporting our people and ensuring transparent and ethical corporate
governance.

[Read more .][20]

# Career

We are looking for talents. Should you wish to work with one of the most dynamic teams in the
industry, please share your CV with us at [career@alvionpharma.com ][21]

# Code of conduct

Alvion is committed to fair and vigorous competition because this is essential to ensure appropriate
and fair market and even more so to ensure full access to affordable healthcare. Alvion does not
tolerate any breach or possible infringement of any competition laws and regulations in any of its
businesses.

[Read more .][22]

## Home Page

Welcome to African Glue Industries, the leading supplier of animal glues to Africa. Based in Port
Elizabeth, **African Glue Industries** (AGI) has been in the business for over 20 years and
specialises in TECHNICAL gelatine products. AGI distributes gelatine nationally throughout South
Africa as well as exporting to the rest of Africa, offering a high quality gelatine at competitive
prices. Over the years we have built an outstanding reputation for quality and service because we
are dependable.


***Technical Gelatine*** or ***Animal Glue*** differs from edible and pharmaceutical gelatine
principally in that it is not essential that they meet the rigid specifications for human
consumption set forth by the various municipal, state and federal governments to protect the health
of the general public – this product is a NATURAL ADHESIVE and is classified into two main types,
***Bone Glue*** and ***Hide Glue***. The differences between them are due largely to the different
methods of processing. It is an adhesive of great versatility with broad acceptance in industry and
is widely used in various fields.

GO GREEN

Incorporate Natural adhesives into your production process. Consider the environmental impact these
materials will have both pre and post manufacture.

Protein based adhesives are ENVIROMENTALLY SAFE, BIODEGRADEBLE, WATER SOLUBLE AND DISSOLVES EASILY!

Unlike hot melts and resins, natural adhesives will never interfere with a products recyclability.

# Gelatina e hidrolizados de colágeno

**Juncà Gelatines** es una empresa de origen familiar fundada en 1947 y **especializada en la
producción de gelatina e hidrolizado de colágeno**. Nuestra apuesta por los **más altos y
exigentes** **métodos** de **calidad**, **seguridad** y **cuidadosa selección de las materias primas
**nos han convertido en una de las empresas referentes en el sector.

En 2021 Juncà Gelatines se convirtió en empresa hermana de Lapi Gelatine Spa[** **][11]y Dispro
Invest. Las tres empresas no solo comparten una larga trayectoria en la producción y distribución de
gelatina y colágeno, sino también los mismos valores en cuanto a altos estándares de calidad y
seguridad de **productos 100% europeos**.

Esta nueva organización nos permite cubrir mejor las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

Ofrecemos una amplia gama de gelatinas e hidrolizados de colágeno de máxima calidad. Gelatina
alimentaria, farmacéutica, e hidrolizados de gelatina y de colágeno dietético.

**Aplicaciones**

por las certificaciones ISO 9001:2015 y FSSC 22000.

# Gelatina e hidrolizados de colágeno

**Juncà Gelatines** es una empresa de origen familiar fundada en 1947 y **especializada en la
producción de gelatina e hidrolizado de colágeno**. Nuestra apuesta por los **más altos y
exigentes** **métodos** de **calidad**, **seguridad** y **cuidadosa selección de las materias primas
**nos han convertido en una de las empresas referentes en el sector.

En 2021 Juncà Gelatines se convirtió en empresa hermana de Lapi Gelatine Spa[** **][11]y Dispro
Invest. Las tres empresas no solo comparten una larga trayectoria en la producción y distribución de
gelatina y colágeno, sino también los mismos valores en cuanto a altos estándares de calidad y
seguridad de **productos 100% europeos**.

Esta nueva organización nos permite cubrir mejor las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:

expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

## Sağlıklı ve Dengeli bir yaşam için Halavet Collagen

Kolajen ile Sağlığınızı Destekleyin

Halavet Collagen, yüksek kaliteli sığır derisinden elde edilen kolajen hidrolizat ile vücudumuzun
ihtiyaç duyduğu protein desteğini sağlamaktadır. Bu amaca uygun olarak, yüksek biyoaktif peptit
içerikli Halavet Collagen, cilt, saç, tırnak ve eklem sağlığımızı korumaya yardımcı, yüksek kalite
ve saflıkta üretilen bir üründür. Gıda, içecek, kozmetik, sağlık ve biyomedikal alanlarında geniş
bir kullanım alanı sunan Halavet Collagen, biyoaktif ve biyouyumlu, emilimi kolay kolajen
hidrolizatlarıyla sağlığımıza önemli katkılar sunmaktadır. Bu bağlamda, yeşil ve doğaya saygılı
üretim süreçlerimizle sürdürülebilirlik ve kaliteyi en üst düzeyde tutuyoruz.

## İlaç Sektöründe Güvenilir ve Çok Yönlü Jelatin

Farmasötik Uygulamalarda Yüksek Performans

Halavet jelatin, ilaç endüstrisinde geniş kullanım alanlarına sahip, yüksek saflıkta bir üründür.
Farmasötik saflıkta üretilen Halavet jelatin yumuşak kapsüllerden sert kapsüllere, tablet
kaplamalarından mikroenkapsülasyon uygulamalarına kadar pek çok alanda etkin bir bileşen olarak
kullanılmaktadır. Ayrıca farma saflıkta üretilen jelatinimiz, üstün biyoyararlınım özelliği
sayesinde ilaç formülasyonlarının vazgeçilmez bir bileşeni ve etkin madde taşıyıcısı olarak
güvenilir çözümler sunmaktadır.

[Daha Fazla][25]

Kaliteli ve Doğal Yenilebilir Jelatin

Sağlığınıza Lezzet Katın

Halavet sığır jelatini, yüksek kaliteli sığır derisinden elde edilen,  gıda ve farma ürünlerinde
güvenle kullanılabilecek doğal bir içerik sunmaktadır. Jelatinimiz, gıda ürünlerine kıvam, esneklik,
stabilite ve doku kazandıran, aynı zamanda yüksek protein içerikli, biyoaktif ve biyouyumlu
fonksiyonel bir üründür.


Şekerlemelerden süt ürünlerine, et ürünlerinden tatlılara, sağlık ve biyomedikal alanlara kadar
geniş bir kullanım alanı sunan Halavet sığır jelatini, doğaya saygılı yüksek teknoloji ve ileri
saflaştırma yöntemleriyle proses edilmektedir.


[01.jpg]

Sürdürülebilir Enerji ile Geleceğe Yatırım

Halavet’in %100 Solar Enerjiyle Çalışan Tesisleri

Halavet Gıda, çevre dostu ve sürdürülebilir enerji çözümlerine olan bağlılığını güçlendirerek,
Türkiye'deki tüm fabrikalarını %100 solar enerjiyle çalıştırmaktadır. Bu adım, enerji tüketimimizi
yenilenebilir kaynaklardan karşılayarak karbon ayak izimizi minimum seviyede tutmamıza ve çevresel
etkilerimizi azaltmamıza olanak tanımaktadır.

 

Güneş enerjisi kullanımı, Halavet’in çevreye duyarlılığının bir göstergesidir ve geleceğe yönelik
sürdürülebilirlik hedeflerimizi desteklemektedir. Bu yaklaşım, sadece üretim süreçlerimizi daha
yeşil hale getirmekle kalmamakta, aynı zamanda tüm değer zincirimizde enerji verimliliği ve çevresel
sorumluluk anlayışımızı da artırmaktadır.

 

Halavet olarak, sürdürülebilir bir gelecek için çalışmaya ve doğayı korumaya devam ediyoruz.

üretim süreçlerimizle sürdürülebilirlik ve kaliteyi en üst düzeyde tutuyoruz.

Farmasötik Uygulamalarda Yüksek Performans

Halavet jelatin, ilaç endüstrisinde geniş kullanım alanlarına sahip, yüksek saflıkta bir üründür.
Farmasötik saflıkta üretilen Halavet jelatin yumuşak kapsüllerden sert kapsüllere, tablet
kaplamalarından mikroenkapsülasyon uygulamalarına kadar pek çok alanda etkin bir bileşen olarak
kullanılmaktadır. Ayrıca farma saflıkta üretilen jelatinimiz, üstün biyoyararlınım özelliği
sayesinde ilaç formülasyonlarının vazgeçilmez bir bileşeni ve etkin madde taşıyıcısı olarak
güvenilir çözümler sunmaktadır.

Halavet’in %100 Solar Enerjiyle Çalışan Tesisleri

Halavet Gıda, çevre dostu ve sürdürülebilir enerji çözümlerine olan bağlılığını güçlendirerek,
Türkiye'deki tüm fabrikalarını %100 solar enerjiyle çalıştırmaktadır. Bu adım, enerji tüketimimizi

yeşil hale getirmekle kalmamakta, aynı zamanda tüm değer zincirimizde enerji verimliliği ve çevresel
sorumluluk anlayışımızı da artırmaktadır.

 

Halavet olarak, sürdürülebilir bir gelecek için çalışmaya ve doğayı korumaya devam ediyoruz.

# Human Body Parts: Complete Guide on Organs, Systems & Labeled Diagrams

[Detailed human anatomy diagram showing major human body parts with names and functions, including

## Overview of Human Body Parts

The human body is a masterpiece of biological engineering — built from 206 bones, approximately 650
skeletal muscles, around 78 organs, and an intricate network of blood vessels stretching over 60,000
miles. At the heart of this architecture lies an extraordinary collaboration of trillions of
specialized cells, each carrying out precise functions that collectively sustain life.

Understanding this remarkable system requires two foundational disciplines. **Anatomy** reveals the
body’s physical structure — mapping its architecture from the microscopic organization of cells and
tissues to the macroscopic arrangement of organs and interconnected systems. **Physiology**, its
inseparable counterpart, explains how those structures function — uncovering the mechanisms that
keep the body alive, balanced, and responsive.

By studying human body parts in detail, we gain far more than a map of the body’s interior. We
develop an understanding of how its diverse components are arranged, how they relate to one another,
and why that organization is essential to health, function, and survival.

## Major Structural Components of the Human Body

### The Skeletal System: 206 Bones

The adult human skeleton comprises **206 bones**, providing mechanical support, protecting vital
organs, enabling movement, storing minerals (primarily calcium and phosphorus), and housing the bone
marrow responsible for blood cell production. Bones are categorized as long, short, flat, irregular,
and sesamoid, each serving distinct anatomical purposes.

### The Muscular System: ~650 Muscles

The human body contains approximately **650 skeletal muscles**, which work in concert with the
skeletal system to produce movement, maintain posture, and generate body heat. Beyond skeletal
muscle, the body also relies on **smooth muscle** (found in the walls of hollow organs) and
**cardiac muscle** (exclusive to the heart) for involuntary and vital functions.

### The Vascular Network: Over 60,000 Miles of Blood Vessels

The circulatory system is an extraordinary anatomical achievement. A vast network of **arteries,
veins, and capillaries** — totaling over 60,000 miles in length — delivers oxygenated blood,
nutrients, hormones, and immune cells to every tissue in the body while removing metabolic waste
products. The heart pumps approximately **5 liters of blood per minute** at rest, adapting output
dynamically based on physiological demand.

### Organs: ~78 Vital Structures

Current anatomical consensus recognizes approximately **78 organs** in the human body, though
definitions vary depending on classification criteria. These range from well-known structures like
the brain, heart, and liver to lesser-discussed organs such as the mesentery, pineal gland, and
thymus. Each organ performs specialized roles essential to homeostasis and overall health.

The human body is a masterpiece of biological engineering — built from 206 bones, approximately 650
skeletal muscles, around 78 organs, and an intricate network of blood vessels stretching over 60,000
miles. At the heart of this architecture lies an extraordinary collaboration of trillions of
specialized cells, each carrying out precise functions that collectively sustain life.

Understanding this remarkable system requires two foundational disciplines. **Anatomy** reveals the
body’s physical structure — mapping its architecture from the microscopic organization of cells and
tissues to the macroscopic arrangement of organs and interconnected systems. **Physiology**, its
inseparable counterpart, explains how those structures function — uncovering the mechanisms that
keep the body alive, balanced, and responsive.

By studying human body parts in detail, we gain far more than a map of the body’s interior. We
develop an understanding of how its diverse components are arranged, how they relate to one another,
and why that organization is essential to health, function, and survival.

## Major Structural Components of the Human Body

### The Skeletal System: 206 Bones

The adult human skeleton comprises **206 bones**, providing mechanical support, protecting vital
organs, enabling movement, storing minerals (primarily calcium and phosphorus), and housing the bone
marrow responsible for blood cell production. Bones are categorized as long, short, flat, irregular,
and sesamoid, each serving distinct anatomical purposes.

### The Muscular System: ~650 Muscles

The human body contains approximately **650 skeletal muscles**, which work in concert with the
skeletal system to produce movement, maintain posture, and generate body heat. Beyond skeletal
muscle, the body also relies on **smooth muscle** (found in the walls of hollow organs) and
**cardiac muscle** (exclusive to the heart) for involuntary and vital functions.

### The Vascular Network: Over 60,000 Miles of Blood Vessels

veins, and capillaries** — totaling over 60,000 miles in length — delivers oxygenated blood,
nutrients, hormones, and immune cells to every tissue in the body while removing metabolic waste
products. The heart pumps approximately **5 liters of blood per minute** at rest, adapting output
dynamically based on physiological demand.

definitions vary depending on classification criteria. These range from well-known structures like

thymus. Each organ performs specialized roles essential to homeostasis and overall health.

## Introduction

From its infancy in 1973, when the company was formed, until date, India Gelatine & Chemicals Ltd.
(IGCL) strives to produce world-class gelatine in its state-of-the-art factory in Vapi, Gujarat. The
journey began more than four decades ago in 1975, when the promoters primarily produced ossein (the
raw material for gelatine) from crushed bones and exported it to Japan with technical collaboration
from M/S Konica Gelatin Corporation of Japan.

Success of this venture, spurred the company to expand its product line and in 1997 it began
producing gelatine from ossein, which was compliant to the highest international standards.

IGCL’s superior product line is fit for consumption in halal and international markets, which has
paved a way for export to USA, the EU, Japan, Korea, Middle eastern countries and Indonesia, amongst
others. The company has been publicly recognized with numerous awards and is poised to grow and meet
the market demand with consummate ease. Its mantra for success is innovation and involvement of all
major stakeholders in the company for an integrated system with refined controls.

As the industry leader, IGCL continues to receive awards annually as a leading exporter from
CAPEXIL- Ministry of Commerce, Govt. of India, as well as cognizance from the Gujarat government for
adhering to pollution control norms and best practices in business.

## Jellice Pioneer Europe B.V.

### We create a Gelatin life style

Jellice Pioneer Europe B.V. is located in Emmen and is the most recent gelatin factory in Europe.
Designed according to the highest up to date standards, but also based on the tradition and
technology of [a well established company][36], experienced in the production of high quality
gelatin and collagen since 1941.

[ ABOUT JELLICE ][37]
[gelatin-lifestyle]

### Part of the Jellice Group

We are a part of the Jellice Group with 7 factories worldwide (Japan, India, China, Taiwan & The
Netherlands), and we have a total yearly capacity of 22.000 tonnes.

 

With our capability of supplying gelatin and collagen from different origins (mainly pigskin, but
also fish, poultry & [bovine bone][38]) we are active within the food, pharmaceutical, health &
cosmetic industries for all sorts of [applications][39].

In our premises in The Netherlands, we are exclusively dedicated to produce pig skin origin gelatin
with a broad range of characteristics well introduced into confectionary, desserts, dairy, meat,
ingredients, beverage, nutritional and health markets.

 

We are committed to achieve the highest quality and product safety standards creating value to our
customers at a competitive price. Our team of professionals will always find the adequate solutions
for your final product.

## Jellice Pioneer Europe B.V.

### We create a Gelatin life style

Jellice Pioneer Europe B.V. is located in Emmen and is the most recent gelatin factory in Europe.
Designed according to the highest up to date standards, but also based on the tradition and
technology of [a well established company][36], experienced in the production of high quality
gelatin and collagen since 1941.

[ ABOUT JELLICE ][37]
[gelatin-lifestyle]

### Part of the Jellice Group

We are a part of the Jellice Group with 7 factories worldwide (Japan, India, China, Taiwan & The
Netherlands), and we have a total yearly capacity of 22.000 tonnes.

 

With our capability of supplying gelatin and collagen from different origins (mainly pigskin, but
also fish, poultry & [bovine bone][38]) we are active within the food, pharmaceutical, health &
cosmetic industries for all sorts of [applications][39].

In our premises in The Netherlands, we are exclusively dedicated to produce pig skin origin gelatin
with a broad range of characteristics well introduced into confectionary, desserts, dairy, meat,
ingredients, beverage, nutritional and health markets.

 

We are committed to achieve the highest quality and product safety standards creating value to our
customers at a competitive price. Our team of professionals will always find the adequate solutions
for your final product.

l’acqua è un prodotto estremamente versatile, utilizzato nei più vari campi di impiego.

Capsule dure e molli,
Compresse, Microincapsulazione

Integratori alimentari per la cura del corpo,
Creme e prodotti di bellezza

# Lebsa – API Manufacturing Company & Supplier

Origin matters. **It’s not only what we do**, but also how **we do it** and who’s behind every
process. In a world of generics, **LEBSA is a unique strategic partner**
as API manufacturing Supplier.

[See more About us][46]

## Our Solutions

### Niche and tailor made API’s

Agile, scalable production, from available products to specific requests with total quality control
and regulatory management.

[PRODUCTS][47]

### Customer focused

Responsive service for the increasingly demanding health industry. We don’t just make API’s, we make
business happen.

[ABOUT US][48]

### Strategic R&D approach

The API industry is quickly becoming more competitive, demanding and complex. We invest in R&D
strategies and new processes.

[VIEW R&D][49]

## Our Brandmark

### Facilities

Everything is done within our own facilities, giving us complete control over operations and
production management.

[View more about facilities][50]

### Regulatory

We provide the **API regulatory support** you need to get your products to market on time in a
complex, interconnected world.

[View more about regulatory][51]

### Quality

LEBSA’s rigorous **API quality assurance** systems provide total peace of mind for our partners in
the **pharma industry.**

[View more about quality][52]

### Environment & Safety

The **respect for the environment** of LEBSA, ensures the correct treatment of solid and liquid
waste management.

## What Is Paleo Diet?

We’ve spent most of our time adapting to the food we ate before the Agricultural Revolution: animal
foods, wild vegetables, and fruits in season, along with limited amounts of nuts & seeds. Our bodies
are built to consume these foods, but this is not what our diets look like today. Paleo is based on
the idea that this mismatch between our bodies and our diet might be the reason for modern health
problems like diabetes, obesity, and heart disease. Just like any other animal, humans suffer when
we stray from our natural diet, but when we return to it, everything changes. Food stops making us
sick and starts making us strong, energetic, and vibrant with health. More than just a diet; it’s a
lifestyle!

## What Is Paleo Diet?

We’ve spent most of our time adapting to the food we ate before the Agricultural Revolution: animal
foods, wild vegetables, and fruits in season, along with limited amounts of nuts & seeds. Our bodies
are built to consume these foods, but this is not what our diets look like today. Paleo is based on
the idea that this mismatch between our bodies and our diet might be the reason for modern health
problems like diabetes, obesity, and heart disease. Just like any other animal, humans suffer when
we stray from our natural diet, but when we return to it, everything changes. Food stops making us
sick and starts making us strong, energetic, and vibrant with health. More than just a diet; it’s a
lifestyle!

## About Prime Proteins

#### Who We Are

At Prime Proteins, we bring over 30 years of industry expertise to the world of B2B ingredient
distribution, specializing in high-quality Gelatin and Collagen Peptides. As a trusted **collagen
and gelatin supplier**, we offer deep knowledge of these ingredients, their applications, and the
industries that rely on them, providing our customers with trusted solutions tailored to their
needs.
Our commitment goes beyond supply—we offer expertise, reliability, and a partnership approach to
help businesses grow and innovate. Whether you're in food, nutrition, pharmaceuticals, or other
specialized markets, Prime Proteins is your **B2B supplier** for premium ingredients—including
**bulk collagen and gelatin**—backed by decades of experience.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

## Thematic and Disruption Research

segment opportunities.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

Choose from thousands of tour options and recommendations before and during your trip to best

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.
